runs.title: Initial full-spec run
runs.detail: Separate Generator and Evaluator sessions independently exposed missing noninteractive write permission. Harness fixed with explicit permission mode.

runs.title: Full-spec build exceeded provider session limit
runs.detail: Partial work was substantial but too large for one unit. This evidence drove milestone decomposition.

runs.title: M1 content verified but uncommitted
runs.detail: Evaluator passed content quality but correctly failed the milestone because role sandbox blocked git commit. Process changed, then Generator-only allowlist was verified.

runs.title: M1: Game content seeding approved
runs.detail: Independent Evaluator PASS. Deliverable includes Sister Cities / The Daily Manifest, seeded needs, gazetteer and mayor-question bank.

runs.title: M1: PASS
runs.detail: M1 (Game content seeding) passed independent evaluation and is merged in the deliverable's main branch. The harness now runs in manual, no-automatic-retry mode while we refine the process.

runs.title: M2: ESCALATED
runs.detail: M2 stopped without an approved result: Coordinator created branch milestone/m2-core-round-flow-engine-lockstep-queue-cycle-fallbacks but could not create its GitHub PR.

runs.title: M2: PASS
runs.detail: M2 passed independent evaluation and its approved PR merged into main.

harnessEvolution: Introduced portable RUNBOOK and doctor check.
Added durable escalation markers and no-op short-circuits.
Split full spec into seven independently gradeable milestones.
Formalized machine-readable verdict format and scoped UNTESTABLE findings.
Disabled automatic retries for current manual Discord operation.
Added Generator-owned milestone branches and review PR lifecycle.
Defined Harness Maintainer authority: automatic knowledge/milestone/process changes; user-only spec and decision changes.

openItems.text: Image-generation modality: does a game-state-informed procedural/SVG image satisfy the per-edition/per-city image requirement, or must a raster image provider be configured?
Create M2 milestone branch + private PR, then run one manual Generator → Evaluator attempt with automatic retries disabled.
